dct_title_s: Buena Vista County, Iowa, 1949, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BZF. Form of individual image numbering: BZF-1F-[number], or BZF-2F-[number]. Date of publication inferred from dates on individual photographs within the mosaic. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
